# Plan: growth pass (2026-11-23). Answers: every default (★) accepted.

Order (Q24 A): graphs + visual → content depth → admin → plans/engine → conditions. Two tracks can run apart:
**Track 1 (frontend)** and **Track 2 (backend + admin + data)**. They meet in `lang/en.ts`/`bn.ts`, `lib/types.ts` (generated by `make types`) and `api-docs/`, so Track 2 owns those files while it runs.

## Track 2: backend + admin + data (built 2026-11-23, session "Track 2")
- [x] Meal log (Q4 A): migration 0034 (`meal_logs`), model/repository/service/controller, `GET|POST /me/profiles/{id}/meals`, `DELETE .../meals/{entry}`, `GET .../meals/range` (92 days max); per-day totals against the limits in `lib/reference.ts` (nine meters: kcal, sugar, sat fat, sodium to stay under; protein, fibre, iron, calcium, potassium to reach); tier feature `meal_log`. Tests: `tests/meal_log.rs`.
- [x] Tier features (Q15): `meal_log`, `charts_pack`, `weekly_report`, `family_sharing`, `data_export` in `FeatureKey` (CHECK widened, defaults seeded: free off; plus meal_log + charts_pack + family_sharing; pro all). Enforced by the API: meals (`meal_log`), range (`meal_log` + `charts_pack`), `/me/profiles/{id}/report/weekly`, shares + `/me/shared` (migration 0035), `/me/export`. Matrix editable by super admin only; live at once (cache flushed on save); `POST /admin/tiers/{slug}/preview` shows the change first.
- [x] Roles (Q14): `medical_reviewer` (migration 0036). Marks rules/conditions reviewed (`POST /admin/food-rules/{id}/review`, `/admin/conditions/{slug}/review`, named account only, never an editor); cannot edit or publish (every admin write now checks the role). Rules carry `source_id`, `reviewed_by`, `reviewed_on`; editing a rule clears its review; a condition goes live only when reviewed and none of its rules changed since (`services/review.rs`, enforced in `PATCH /admin/conditions/{slug}`).
- [x] Engine (Q10, Q11): migration 0037 + `services/criteria.rs`. Criteria: BMI (WHO classes; WHO Asian action points for BD/IN/PK/LK/NP), waist (IDF), activity (WHO), sleep (AASM/SRS), labs vs ranges (HbA1c, fasting glucose, blood pressure, haemoglobin), allergens (closed list, foods forced to avoid), budget (cheaper first, never changes a verdict), cooking score (`cook_score` per variant). Every verdict returns `why` (winning rule, condition, source, reviewed_on, how many others had a say); `insights` carry the cited words from `criteria_notes`. Profile fields saved: height, waist, activity, sleep, budget, allergens. Tests: `tests/engine_criteria.rs`.
- [x] Conditions (Q9): high blood pressure, high cholesterol, gout and acid reflux already shipped with migration 0030 (sourced rules, timing, habits). New: **PCOS** and **anaemia (low iron)** (migration 0038, `seeders/health_more.sql`): every rule names a checked source (NHS, WHO), timing and habits, English + Bangla, no doses. Both ship as **drafts** (inactive) until a medical reviewer reviews them in the admin: I did not mark them reviewed. Sources were opened on 2026-11-23; citation-only entries (2023 PCOS guideline, WHO/IDF papers) are marked as such. CKD stays doctor-first, later.
- [x] Admin (Q13): coverage + review screen (`/admin/coverage`), bulk edit + CSV/JSON import/export with dry run (`/admin/food-rules/{bulk,import,export}`), audit trail with detail panel (`/admin/audit`; every admin write now writes an audit row), content calendar + scheduled publish (`publish_on`, migration 0040), tier matrix preview, media usage, traffic (privacy-safe counter, no personal data) and plan-mix dashboards. Tests: `tests/admin_ops.rs`, `tests/review_workflow.rs`.
- [x] Search (Q18, Q19): in-app index kept; new public `GET /api/v1/search-index` (habits, medicine generics); spotlight now finds habits, medicines and (staff only) admin pages; new conditions appear once live. API docs (Q20): `api-docs/openapi.yaml` has every new endpoint with examples.

## Definition of done
`make check` (cargo + typecheck) green in Docker; env tunables in `docker/.envs/app.env.example`; UI words in `en.ts` + `bn.ts`; verified in the browser at desktop and mobile, light and dark; API docs and search updated.
